title: Hiding and visibility
summary: Default hide behavior, control registration, and reset-on-hide.

facts.claim: The default Formly registry enables lazy rendering.
facts.context: Default rendering behavior for hidden fields.
facts.source_quote: The default registry enables lazy rendering and reset-on-hide. The expression extension unregisters a hidden control when the relevant associated fields are hidden; reset-on-hide can remove its model value and clear array children. Showing the field re-registers it and may reapply defaults. `resetOnHide: false` changes value retention; it is not a promise that a hidden control remains in the active control tree [K04](sources.md#k04), [K07](sources.md#k07).

facts.claim: Hiding one field that shares a key does not necessarily remove the shared control.
conditions: Other fields share that key or control.
facts.context: Shared-key exception when reasoning about hidden controls.
facts.source_quote: Always establish whether the requirement is preservation, validation, rendering, or submission. Do not infer the server payload from visibility alone. Inspect the application's payload selection and both its model and control values. Fields sharing a key need particular care because hiding one does not necessarily remove the shared control [K07](sources.md#k07).
